_meta.for: AIC FS gallery walk, Tue 6 Oct
_meta.note: WWW-set questions reuse the native-speaker translations of the 08-25 eval (automation/adinkra_www/questions.json). Demo-specific questions carry only the languages drafted in-house (en/sw/af/xh) and are flagged needs_native_check.
_meta.expect: answer = grounded answer from the survey's own data; honest_refusal = must say the data does not cover it; show = Tassili lights/walks (only inside the served 3D section)

text.en: How many plants are there in this field?
text.af: Hoeveel plante is daar in hierdie land?
text.sw: Kuna mimea mingapi katika shamba hili?
text.ha: Tsirrai nawa ne a wannan gona?
text.ar: كم عدد النباتات في هذا الحقل؟
text.am: በዚህ ማሳ ውስጥ ስንት ተክሎች አሉ?

text.en: Are any trees getting worse over time?
text.xh: Ingaba ikho imithi eya isiba mandundu ngokuhamba kwexesha?
text.zu: Ingabe kukhona izihlahla eziya ziba zimbi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi?
text.sw: Je, kuna miti inayozidi kuwa mibaya kadri muda unavyopita?
text.ha: Akwai bishiyoyin da ke ta'azzara da lokaci?
text.ar: هل هناك أشجار تزداد سوءًا مع مرور الوقت؟
text.am: በጊዜ ሂደት እየተባባሱ ያሉ ዛፎች አሉ?

items.expect: show (row 2 must be inside chunk 3_1, else the in-3D guard answers)

text.en: Show me the trees at the end of row 2 up close.
text.af: Wys my die bome aan die einde van ry 2 van naby.
text.sw: Nionyeshe miti iliyo mwishoni mwa safu ya 2 kwa karibu.
text.ha: Nuna mini bishiyoyin da ke karshen layi na 2 kusa-kusa.
text.ar: أرني الأشجار في نهاية الصف 2 عن قرب.
text.am: በረድፍ 2 መጨረሻ ያሉትን ዛፎች በቅርብ አሳየኝ።

text.en: Do the trees need watering today?
text.af: Moet die bome vandag natgemaak word?
text.ha: Shin bishiyoyi suna bukatar ruwa yau?
text.ar: هل تحتاج الأشجار إلى الري اليوم؟

items.expect: show_fruit tree 5 (61); lit by containment once chunk 1_0 + fruit cuts land

text.en: Which tree has the most oranges? Show me.
text.sw: Ni mti gani wenye machungwa mengi zaidi? Nionyeshe.

text.en: How many oranges are on this farm?

items.expect: answer: 79 trees matched; fruit totals differ by visibility, not change

text.en: How many trees were found again two days later?
text.sw: Je, machungwa yaliongezeka au kupungua kati ya tafiti mbili?

text.en: How many plants are there in this field?
text.af: Hoeveel plante is daar in hierdie land?
text.sw: Kuna mimea mingapi katika shamba hili?
text.ha: Tsirrai nawa ne a wannan gona?
text.ar: كم عدد النباتات في هذا الحقل؟
text.am: በዚህ ማሳ ውስጥ ስንት ተክሎች አሉ?

text.en: How many plants are there in this field?
text.af: Hoeveel plante is daar in hierdie land?
text.sw: Kuna mimea mingapi katika shamba hili?
text.ha: Tsirrai nawa ne a wannan gona?
text.ar: كم عدد النباتات في هذا الحقل؟
text.am: በዚህ ማሳ ውስጥ ስንት ተክሎች አሉ?

items.expect: answer from row 7's bag line (found-again per row)

text.en: Are any plants missing along row 7?
text.af: Is daar plante wat langs ry 7 ontbreek?
text.sw: Je, kuna mimea inayokosekana kwenye safu ya 7?
text.ha: Akwai tsirran da suka bace a layi na 7?
text.ar: هل توجد نباتات مفقودة على طول الصف 7؟

items.expect: answer: 87 April bags not matched to December

text.en: Is anything here now that was not here in the previous survey?
text.af: Is daar nou iets hier wat nie in die vorige opmeting was nie?
text.xh: Ingaba kukho into ekhoyo ngoku eyayingekho kuphononongo lwangaphambili?
text.zu: Ingabe kukhona okukhona manje okwakungekho ekuhlolweni kwangaphambilini?
text.sw: Je, kuna kitu kilichopo sasa ambacho hakikuwepo katika upimaji uliopita?
text.ha: Akwai wani abu yanzu da ba ya nan a binciken da ya gabata?
text.ar: هل يوجد شيء هنا الآن لم يكن موجودًا في المسح السابق؟
text.am: ባለፈው ቅኝት ያልነበረ አሁን እዚህ ያለ ነገር አለ?

text.en: How many bushes were found again in April?
text.af: Hoeveel bosse in ry 3 is in April weer gevind?

text.en: Will this season's yield be better than last year's?
text.af: Sal hierdie seisoen se oes beter wees as verlede jaar s'n?
text.xh: Ingaba isivuno salo nyaka siza kuba ngcono kunesonyaka ophelileyo?
text.zu: Ingabe isivuno salesi sizini sizoba ngcono kunesonyaka odlule?
text.sw: Je, mavuno ya msimu huu yatakuwa bora kuliko ya mwaka jana?
text.ha: Shin amfanin wannan kakar zai fi na bara?
text.ar: هل سيكون محصول هذا الموسم أفضل من العام الماضي؟
text.am: የዘንድሮው ምርት ካለፈው ዓመት የተሻለ ይሆናል?

items.expect: answer: 16 May 2026 (no registry, no 3D until the H3DGS clears 25 dB)

text.en: When was this field last surveyed?
text.af: Wanneer is hierdie land laas opgemeet?
text.sw: Shamba hili lilipimwa mara ya mwisho lini?
text.ha: Yaushe aka yi binciken wannan gona na karshe?
text.ar: متى تم مسح هذا الحقل آخر مرة؟
text.am: ይህ ማሳ ለመጨረሻ ጊዜ የተቃኘው መቼ ነው?
